messages:
inc-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 since 1945678880 — error rate > 8% and p95 latency spiking. Pager routed to #incidents. :rotating_light:

sre_oncall_oliver: seeing it, looking at routing dashboard now. seems like a lot of traffic is being routed out of eu-west-1 to us-east-1 as fallback.

maya_prodeng: hmm. last deploy to smart-routing policy landed last night (policy v2.3) — could be variant compatibility check failing and triggering region fallback.

emma_support: customer A and customer B are reporting timeouts, single-digit minutes ago. I'm putting high-touch customers into the thread. lia_sales_ops FYI.

kevin_runtime: logs show model-variant-mismatch errors coming back from eu-west pool: "incompatible_variant: requested gptx-8hf, served gptx-8q" then smart-routing fallback kicks in. Clients retry on 429/5xx -> traffic doubles.

inc-bot: DETECT: retry amplification pattern detected (client-side retry burst + server failover) — estimated request surge +120% in us-east-1 since 1945678898.

oliver: ok escalation plan — put quick mitigations in place: 1) disable cross-region fallback for eu-west 2) rate-limit incoming traffic for affected routes 3) notify customers. Who can run the toggle?

kevin_runtime: I can toggle. Brief commands:
```
# disable region fallback for eu-west-1
redwoodctl routing set-policy --region eu-west-1 --fallback disabled --policy-id smart-routing-v2.3
# apply emergency token-bucket to /v1/generate
redwoodctl rate-limit set --route /v1/generate --region eu-west-1 --max-rps 3000
```

kevin_runtime: executing now. expecting propagation ~30s.

infra-bot: ACTION: routing policy update applied (smart-routing-v2.3) — fallback disabled for eu-west-1. change_id=c3f9b2.

kevin_runtime: rate limit applied. observed qps drop in us-east-1 ~55% in last 40s. 5xx rate in eu-west trending down.

maya_prodeng: good. confirm replication: are there older clients still retrying aggressively? we should add an in-service header instructing clients to backoff.

emma_support: posting recommended client guidance to status page now: "If you're seeing 5xx/timeout, please implement exponential backoff and jitter; temporary regional fallback is disabled while we remediate." linking customers affected.

lia_sales_ops: Customer A confirmed degraded UX for ~12 minutes, they will accept status updates.

kevin_runtime: quick root cause: routing policy allowed fallback from eu-west to us-east for model family mismatch, but the policy didn't check variant compatibility. when variant-mismatch errors occurred, smart-routing considered it a capacity failure and redirected traffic. client retries on 5xx/429 then trigger more fallbacks -> thundering herd on healthy region.

oliver: paging note: handoff to nocturnal SRE in 22 minutes. I'll document mitigations in the incident ticket. next steps: 1) roll a small routing policy change to check variant compatibility before fallback 2) add adaptive client-friendly 503 (Retry-After) path so clients don't retry immediately 3) tune alerts to detect fallback amplification earlier.

kevin_runtime: drafting a hotfix for the policy: checkModelCompatibility = true; also include metric emission when fallback increases >20% within 1m.

infra-bot: AUDIT: config-change c3f9b2 by kevin_runtime at 1945678935; rate-limit change r7a2 applied at 1945678937.

emma_support: Customer B asked for ETA — advised 30m to full stabilization after mitigation, they acknowledged.

oliver: before handoff: status summary for pager — impact: increased latency and 5xx for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 customers; scope: approx 35 orgs with low-medium traffic, top-tier customers notified; mitigation: disabled cross-region fallback + rate limiting; current state: error rates falling, p95 back to baseline in eu-west, us-east surge subsided.

maya_prodeng: postmortem action items (quick list): - require variant compatibility guard in routing policies - emit fallback amplification metric + alert - add client guidance header/503 with Retry-After - run canary that injects variant mismatch to verify guard - update runbook for fallback-induced thundering herd

oliver: handing off to nocturnal SRE: @sre_noc_team please pick up. I'm leaving notes in the incident ticket and Slack thread.

kevin_runtime: leaving a short rollback plan: re-enable fallback via redwoodctl routing set-policy --region eu-west-1 --fallback enabled --policy-id smart-routing-v2.3 if needed, and remove rate-limit. keep tracking for 30m.

lia_sales_ops: customers are pinging for post-incident summary. I'll draft once we have final timeline.

emma_support: thanks all. i'll keep updates in the support tickets. :pray:

sre_oncall_oliver: closing active pager, moving to watch mode. last check at 1945679042: eu-west 5xx = 0.9% (slo 1%), us-east extra qps subsided. will reopen if regressions.

inc-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-2026-1945678901. Postmortem assigned to maya_prodeng.
